title: Verification runner completion, local screenshots, verify report
goal: `npm run verify` is the complete local and live acceptance tool (crawl, full browser audit matrix, external-link sample, meta table, print, screenshots) and the repo carries the real-build screenshot set and report that the reviewer and the ship step rely on (DR-6).
description: Complete scripts/verify.mjs (--live, --shots, external sampling, meta table, --all matrix), finalise scripts/audit.py, commit docs/verify-report.json and the 33 local screenshots, add the README 'Verification' section, bring status.md up to date.
steps: Read FIRST: context.json, this file, plan.md 'Verification matrix' and Decisions 23, design.md 'Verification plan', reviews/design-verdict.json DR-6, the brief's P5/P6 (in the step prompt), FEAT-002…006 findings.

scripts/verify.mjs additions: `--live <url>` (skip the local server; crawl the live pages listed by the sitemap-free rule: fetch each known page name from dist's inventory; audit against the live base URL; cache-busting `?cb=<ts>` on data/meta.json); `--shots <prefix>` → pass through to audit.py which saves viewport-only PNGs (`full_page=False`) for index, s12, plan, feed at 390×844 (dsf 1), 1440×900 (1), 1920×1080 (1), 2560×1440 (dsf 0.75 → 1920×1080 PNG) in light and dark, plus s03 at 1920 light, named `<prefix><page>-<width>-<theme>.png`; external-link sample: collect all http(s) hrefs from dist (or live) pages, group by host, take every k-th distinct host so that 40 links are sampled deterministically, HEAD then GET fallback with a 10 s timeout and the browser-like UA, record status counts (2xx/3xx/403/404/429/5xx/timeout/other) in the report, NEVER fail on 403 or anti-bot — report it; read data/meta.json (local or live) and print a per-source table (id, class, status, newest, error/note) into the report and to stdout; `--all` runs the cheap checks (overflow, fonts, contrast, controls) on all 24 section pages and the full groups on the 7 page types; print audit at 1440 on s12 (already in audit.py) included in the default run; report path default docs/verify-report.json with a `summary` {pagesAudited, widths, themes, checks, failures, minContrast: {light, dark}, minTextPx, bodyPx: {390, 2560}, contentRatio: {1920, 2560}, externalLinks: {sampled, counts}, screenshots: [...]}; exit 1 on any threshold failure, 0 otherwise.

Run `npm run verify -- --all --shots docs/screenshots/` → 33 PNGs in docs/screenshots/ named index-390-light.png … feed-2560-dark.png + s03-1920-light.png. Check every PNG's pixel dimensions with Add-Type System.Drawing (390×844, 1440×900, 1920×1080, and 1920×1080 for the 2560 set) BEFORE opening any; open at most four (one per tool call: index-1920-light, s12-390-dark, plan-1440-light, feed-1920-light) to confirm they show the real site like the mocks; note observations in findings. Never open an image larger than 1920 px per side.

README.md: add a 'Verification' section (what `npm run verify` checks, the thresholds, where the report and screenshots live, how the ship step runs it against the live site with `--live https://sudish007.github.io/physical-ai-roadmap/ --shots docs/screenshots/live-`).

status.md: one row per FEAT-001…007 with state done, commit hash and the one-line verification result; keep the DR-6 note that the 30 stale mock shots are not evidence and that docs/screenshots/*.png is the evidence set; add the verify summary numbers.

Run `npm test`. Fix ANY hard-UI-rule violation the full matrix reveals on ANY page and report it (this is the first time all 24 section pages get the full run). Set this file's status to completed; record findings: the summary numbers, external-link status counts, the per-source table, and the exact commands the fixer and the reviewer should run.

Commit on main: `feat(FEAT-007): verification runner completion, local screenshots, verify report` (includes docs/verify-report.json and docs/screenshots/*.png) with the commands and the summary numbers in the body. Never push.

acceptance.outcome: The whole site passes the full audit matrix.
acceptance.audit: `npm run verify -- --all --shots docs/screenshots/` exits 0; docs/verify-report.json: failures [] over 28 pages × 8 widths × 2 themes; minContrast ≥4.5 both themes; minTextPx ≥12; bodyPx 390 ≥17 and 2560 ≥21; contentRatio ≥0.88 at 1920/2560.

acceptance.outcome: Real-build screenshots exist as the evidence set (DR-6).
acceptance.audit: 33 PNGs with the expected pixel sizes (System.Drawing), each ≤1920 px per side, timestamps after the FEAT-006 commit.

acceptance.outcome: Every internal link and fragment resolves; external links are sampled honestly.
acceptance.audit: crawl: 0 broken hrefs, 0 missing fragments; externalLinks.sampled == 40 with status counts (403s reported, not failed).

acceptance.outcome: The live mode is ready for the ship step.
acceptance.audit: `node scripts/verify.mjs --live http://127.0.0.1:<port>/physical-ai-roadmap/ --no-external` against the local server behaves like the local run (same checks, same report shape).

acceptance_criteria: README Verification section present; status.md complete
verification: PowerShell: Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing; Get-ChildItem docs/screenshots/*.png | ForEach-Object { $i=[System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile($_.FullName); "$($_.Name) $($i.Width)x$($i.Height)"; $i.Dispose() }
node scripts/verify.mjs --live http://127.0.0.1:<port>/physical-ai-roadmap/ --no-external (with npm run serve in the background; taskkill after)
mandatoryReviewItems: DR-6: docs/screenshots/*.png (real build) is the evidence set; mock shots are never cited.
P5: the reviewer opens these screenshots one per call after checking dimensions and re-runs `npm run verify -- --all` itself.
P6: `node scripts/verify.mjs --live https://sudish007.github.io/physical-ai-roadmap/ --shots docs/screenshots/live-` is the ship command.

VERIFY.MJS API (scripts/verify.mjs): flags --pages, --all, --widths, --themes, --report (default docs/verify-report.json), --no-browser, --no-external (new), --shots <prefix> (resolved against the repo root; a trailing / is kept, so docs/screenshots/ is a directory prefix and docs/screenshots/live- a file prefix), --live <url> (must be http(s); a trailing / is added). Exports: parseArgs, findFreePort, allPages, analyzePages(Map<file, html>) → {refs, broken, styleAttrs, prevNext, assets: Map<target, referrer>, external[]}, crawl(distDir) (now also returns the assets count and the external hrefs), crawlLive(base, seedNames), probeUrl(url, {timeoutMs, fetchImpl}) (HEAD → GET fallback, never throws), classifyStatus, sampleExternal(urls, n) → {sample, hosts, urls}, probeExternal(urls, opts) → report block {sampled, requested, distinctUrls, distinctHosts, rule, timeoutMs, counts, links[{url, host, method, status, class, headStatus, ms, note}]}, formatExternal, metaRows, formatMetaTable, readMeta(liveBase or ''), resolveShotsPrefix, relToRepo, buildSummary, linkCounts, protocolCells, formatReport, main; constants EXTERNAL_SAMPLE 40, EXTERNAL_TIMEOUT_MS 10000, EXTERNAL_CONCURRENCY 6, STATUS_CLASSES, REQUEST_HEADERS (the pipeline's BROWSER_USER_AGENT). The external sample starts right after the crawl and is awaited after the browser audit (independent work overlaps; its output prints after the audit). Exit codes: 0 pass, 1 any threshold failure (crawl broken/style attrs, audit failure, shots requested but none written, meta unreadable), 2 venv Python missing.

AUDIT.PY CHANGES: SHOT_PAGES = index,s12,plan,feed (default --shot-pages), SHOT_EXTRAS = "s03:1920:light" (default --shot-extras, comma-separated <page>:<width>:<theme>, empty for none), SHOT_MAX_SIDE 1920; shot() waits for the home/feed lists to render before the capture, measures the PNG IHDR and records the check shotPixels (expected == viewport × dsf and ≤1920 per side; THRESHOLDS["shotPixels"]); report.shots entries now carry dsf, pixels (expected), measured and ok; feed_data() fetches data/feed.json and data/meta.json with ?cb=<ts> (CDN-safe on --live; serve.mjs ignores the query).

TESTS: npm test = 139 tests / 28 files pass, 0 fail, ≈4.9 s, no network (3 new tests in tests/verify-cli.test.js: the external sample rule incl. determinism and the few-hosts round-robin; status classes and probeUrl with an injected fetch (HEAD 405 → GET 403 cloudflare, 204, TimeoutError, ECONNREFUSED); meta rows/table formatting and the summary shape; plus parseArgs --no-external / --live normalisation and the crawl's assets/external fields).

DECISIONS TAKEN HERE (not covered by D1–D11 / plan Decisions): (a) the external sample never fails the run for any status (the FEAT names 403/anti-bot; 404/5xx/timeouts are listed per link in report.external.links and on stdout so the reviewer and the ship step can judge them); (b) with fewer than 40 distinct hosts the sampler takes the first URL of every host and then round-robins over later URLs, so a small site still gets 40 links when they exist; (c) redirects are not followed (manual), so a 3xx is reported as such with its Location — a moved link is information for the content owner; (d) the live crawl treats a direct 404.html request answered with HTTP 404 as present (GitHub Pages behaviour) and every other non-200 page as broken; (e) the audit's DR-3/DR-4/specials run unchanged in live mode (the clipboard permission is granted to the live origin); (f) report.summary keeps pass/failures/elapsedSeconds in front of the FEAT's fields; (g) the follow-up docs(FEAT-007) hash-record commit follows the FEAT-001…006 procedure.

COMMANDS FOR THE FIXER AND THE REVIEWER (from the repo root c:/Users/sudiskmr/Downloads/DomainClassification/physical-ai-roadmap/): `npm test` (expect 139 pass); `npm run build` (expect `pages 28 · h3 89 · chips 127 · crossrefs 113 rewritten / 5 skipped · manifest 7/10/36/12/14/26/9/24/24/8 · search 965 records · bytes 1375657`); `npm run verify -- --all --shots docs/screenshots/` (expect VERIFY PASS, 28 pages, 5863 checks, 0 failures, 33 screenshots, external 40 sampled; ≈2.5 min; it rewrites docs/verify-report.json and the 33 PNGs — commit them only when the numbers are unchanged or the change is intended); dimensions BEFORE opening any image: `Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing; Get-ChildItem docs/screenshots/*.png | ForEach-Object { $i=[System.Drawing.Image]::FromFile($_.FullName); "$($_.Name) $($i.Width)x$($i.Height)"; $i.Dispose() }` (expect 390x844 ×8, 1440x900 ×8, 1920x1080 ×17; never open an image above 1920 px per side; one image per tool call); live rehearsal: `$env:PORT=8797; Start-Process node -ArgumentList 'scripts/serve.mjs' -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru` → `node scripts/verify.mjs --live http://127.0.0.1:8797/physical-ai-roadmap/ --no-external --report $env:TEMP/live.json` → `taskkill /PID <pid> /T /F` (expect PASS, 2449 checks); ship: `node scripts/verify.mjs --live https://sudish007.github.io/physical-ai-roadmap/ --shots docs/screenshots/live-`, then read report.meta for the per-source table (plan Decision 8 on reg-nist) and report.external.counts.

CAVEATS: the --all run with screenshots takes ≈2.5 min on this PC and the external sample adds ≈2–10 s (overlapped with the audit); the external results depend on the network of the machine running them (a GitHub-hosted runner would see different 403s) — the counts are a report, not a gate; docs/verify-report.json is ≈1.2 MB (one audit check per line) and changes on every run (generatedAt, elapsed, external ms); the plan screenshots show the audit fixture (10 h, Track B, started 14 days before the run), so their dates move with the run date; the first-paint (DR-3) contexts never receive PAGE_INIT or the theme seed; a `^C`-truncated tool output while verify runs means the process is still running in the background — wait for the VERIFY line (tee the output to a $env:TEMP log) instead of restarting.
